definition: I. חֶ֫רֶס noun masculine Judg 14:18 sun (Late Hebrew id. ) — absolute ׳ ח Job 9:7 (|| כוכבים ); with ה epenth. בְּטֶרֶם יָבֹא הַחַ֫רְסָה Judg 14:18 (compare לַיִל , לַיְלָה ) before the sun could go down (but read perhaps הַחַ֫דְרָה into the (bridal) chamber Sta ZAW 1884, 253 f f. ).
